Name: Overnight Growth Fertilizer
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
🌱 Overnight Growth Fertilizer
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Overnight Growth Fertilizer[/b] gives your farm a simple way to speed up plant growth. Apply this special fertilizer to a supported growing plant, go to sleep, and wake up to see the plant [b]fully grown and ready[/b] the next morning.
At just [b]300g[/b], the fertilizer provides an affordable shortcut for farmers who want to save valuable in-game time while keeping the rest of the farming experience unchanged.
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/*]
[*]Download [b]Overnight Growth Fertilizer[/b]. [/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder. [/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. [/*]
[*]Obtain the fertilizer and apply it to a supported growing plant. [/*]
[*]Go to sleep and check your farm the next morning. [/*]
